text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position from the opening and closing","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and returns to it at the end, so the reader always knows the essay’s argument."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on safety, fuel use, and liability","quality":"organized support","description":"It develops its claim in separate body paragraphs that each focus on a distinct reason or counterpoint."},{"evidence":"references to sensors, roadwork, accidents, and half the fuel","quality":"text-based evidence","description":"It uses several specific details from the article to support its claims rather than relying mostly on general statements."},{"evidence":"acknowledges accidents and liability concerns","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It recognizes a serious drawback and responds to it instead of presenting the issue as one-sided."},{"evidence":"mostly direct, topic-focused wording","quality":"control of expression","description":"Its sentences stay more centered on the argument and are less distracted by rambling or off-topic digressions."}]}
